title: Hero's Enchants
description: This is a collection of fun enchants that I made, including some unique mace abilities.
body:
This mod adds:
- Dash; A simple dash ability applicable to swords and maces.
- Igneous; A fire based mace enchant that makes a small crater at the location of a mace attack.
- Bone Breaker; An enchant that has a 1/5 chance to stun the attacked entity will get slowness 5 for 5-10 seconds.
- Windjump; a WindBurst-like ability that activates on right click with the enchanted mace. Has 4 second cooldown.
- Static Shock; A lightning-based enchant that, when applied to a mace, strikes on a slam attack. But when applied to a non-mace weapon, it has a 1/3 chance to strike.
